name: GetActiveCellOnExcelWorksheetNode
label: Get Active Cell on Excel Worksheet
description: Retrieves the address and value of the currently active cell in the specified Excel worksheet.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: WorksheetInstance
fields.label: Worksheet Instance
fields.description: The Excel Worksheet from which to get the active cell.

fields.name: ActiveCellColumn
fields.label: Active Cell Column
fields.description: The column letter of the active cell.

fields.name: ActiveCellRow
fields.label: Active Cell Row
fields.description: The row number of the active cell.

fields.name: ActiveCellValue
fields.label: Active Cell Value
fields.description: The value of the active cell.

fields.name: ActiveCellAddress
fields.label: Active Cell Address
fields.description: The full address of the active cell (e.g., '$A$1').
